policy_rule: Models with parameter count > 3B must run exclusively in cloud compute. 3B base models run in cloud via explicit approval. Local storage is strictly restricted to metadata, adapters <= 32MB, and mock unit tests.

local_backbone_weights_gt_3b.notes: Zero >3B backbone weights exist on local disk.

stage03_3b_base_weights_local.notes: Base Qwen2.5-3B weights (~7 GB) reside on HuggingFace Hub / Cloud storage, not downloaded to local disk.

local_adapter_weights_compliance.notes: All local adapter weights are within the 32 MB safety envelope.
